{\normalsize How many ambulances for nine good days in ten? A conformal staffing rule tested in seven EMS service areas\par}

\noindent Exploratory analyses of the analysis-plan amendments 2 to 4. All numbers are generated from the result files of the analysis (see the Data availability statement of the manuscript).

\begin{table}[h]
\centering
\caption{All exploratory rules (second to fourth amendments) against SCD, primary configuration (80 training days, 90\% target, at most 5\% of calls delayed). ACI: adaptive level; WCP: recency-weighted calibration; QT: quantile tracking; SCD-I: SCD plus integrator; TAB: trend-adjusted base load; CRC-share: conformal risk control of the expected share of delayed calls; ACA0: band on call counts without the Erlang-C margin. Coverage: range over the seven areas. Below 0.90: number of areas. H1 criterion: number of areas whose lower 95\% bound of coverage is at least 0.85, with the pre-specified bootstrap seed (range over 50 seeds); descriptive, not a test. Extra unit-hours: range over areas of the ratio of mean unit-hours to SCD's, minus one. $\rho$: Spearman correlation between window coverage and the growth of demand from the calibration days to the test window, pooled over areas. $H$: half-life in weekdays. QT and SCD-I use the step factor 0.1.}
